propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 800 lines with intermingled concerns: file loading, unknown-field preservation, tempfile cleanup, JSON encoding, rotation ordering, retired-state replacement, and alert persistence, creating risk of silent data loss during refactoring

a new private BindingRepository must be extracted as a unit-of-work owning paths and original dictionaries while preserving every existing byte, exception contract, and load/save behavior behind an unchanged BindingStore facade
rotation-before-live order, inline rotation floor, retired-first move ordering, best-effort alert writes, and exact sorted/indented/trailing-newline serialization must be preserved during extraction

given tempfile, rotation replace, retired replace, live replace, alert write, and selective commit failures, the extracted repository must produce identical surviving file bytes and raise/swallow behavior as the original implementation
tickets publication must remain an external five-file allowlisted seam in reconcile_helpers.py with no broad staging or per-checkpoint publish
the binding-lifecycle ADR must distinguish repository unit-of-work durability from tickets publication and record the exact-match recovery boundary
